title: Prompting Away Stereotypes? Evaluating Bias in Text-to-Image Models for Occupations

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images of five socially significant occupations using neutral baseline prompts versus fairness-aware controlled prompts, followed by manual annotation of perceived gender (male/female) to analyze demographic distributions, stereotype alignment, and prompt-induced shifts.

Generating images of five socially significant occupations using neutral baseline prompts versus fairness-aware controlled prompts, followed by manual annotation of perceived race/ethnicity (Asian, Black, White) to measure representation, disparities, and the risk of overcorrection.
